name: Donut Theory
author: kim
summary: Analog-inspired synthesizer for bass, keys, leads and pads, with two oscillators, dual LFOs and up to 16 editable chord slots. Requires MPC OS 3.10.1 or later.

manifest.name: Donut Theory
manifest.about: Soulful polyphonic synth with up to sixteen editable chord slots and independent sound/progression presets.

versions.notes:
# Donut Theory 1.14.2

- Aligned front selectors to one or two knob columns, with consistent heights and spacing.
- FREE/SYNC now sits directly above its Rate control on the performance and MOD pages. Motion Sync no longer occupies the section title.
- Standardized the footer VOICE, Dice Target and input selector widths.
- Added consistent list text/arrow padding and a compact TIME layout that leaves room for numeric units.
- Original artwork, fonts, knob geometry, sound engine, 391 parameter definitions and all Q-Link assignments are preserved.

Native/ARM32/ARM64 builds and SDK validation pass with no errors or warnings. Skin checks pass; host simulator:19PASS/0WARN/0FAIL. Actual MPC XL / OS3.10.1.12 remote checks cover all seven pages, selector rendering, focus, Sync switching and representative sidebars. NVMe and SD copies each passed247-file installation verification. Physical encoder/audio/CPU and full project recall certification remain separate.

Requires MPC standalone OS3.10.1+ and Enhancements / External Plugin Support. Copy the complete folder to `VST2 Plugins` and restart/rescan after saving work. Keep one active copy across attached drives. UID kim/Krql,66factory programs and existing state meanings are unchanged.
